name: Rendez-Doug
source:
Doug isn't the type of guy people usually notice, due to his bland personality and his shocking lack of charisma. However, he seems to be sadder one day, which his two co-workers, Sandra and Adriel, don't fail to notice... Perhaps it's due to the wedding ring he stopped wearing? In any case, one of them decides to spend time with him to brighten his day... but perhaps Doug can brighten their lives in return.

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/rendez-doug]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
道格不是人们通常会注意到的那种人，因为他性格温和，缺乏魅力，令人震惊。然而，有一天他似乎变得更加悲伤，他的两位同事桑德拉和阿德里尔都注意到了这一点……也许是因为他不再戴结婚戒指了？无论如何，他们中的一个人决定花时间和他在一起，让他的一天变得美好……但也许道格可以回报他们的生活。

[来自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/rendez-doug]itch.io[/url]]
